title: A cell-type-resolved proteomic atlas reveals intra- and intercellular signaling in Alzheimer’s disease
title_zh: 阿尔茨海默病细胞类型分辨蛋白质组图谱揭示细胞内及细胞间信号传导
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) arises from pathological interactions among diverse brain cell types, but cell-type-specific proteomic changes remain underexplored. Here, we present deep proteomic profiling of sorted or proximity-labeled brain cells from AD mouse models (5xFAD and AppNL-G-F) at multiple ages, quantifying 13,411 proteins in microglia, astrocytes, oligodendrocyte precursor cells, and neurons, with additional spatial information. We identified 3,028 differentially abundant proteins, most of which were absent in a bulk proteomic dataset, and constructed cell-type-specific networks to define functional modules and hub proteins. Comparison with transcriptomic data revealed that ∼30% of proteomic changes are RNA discordant. Further analyses uncovered cross-cell-type signaling proteins conserved in human AD brains, such as pleiotrophin (Ptn), which is transcriptionally enriched in astrocytes but accumulates in microglia. Importantly, recombinant PTN activates human induced microglia (iMG) cells. Thus, these findings provide a comprehensive cell-type-resolved proteomic atlas of AD models, highlighting novel intra- and intercellular signaling events.
abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）源于不同脑细胞类型之间的病理相互作用，但细胞类型特异性的蛋白质组变化尚未得到充分研究。本文报道了基于5xFAD和AppNL-G-F阿尔茨海默病小鼠模型在不同年龄的分选或近邻标记脑细胞进行的深度蛋白质组分析，在小胶质细胞、星形胶质细胞、少突胶质前体细胞和神经元中定量了13,411种蛋白质，并获得了额外的空间信息。我们鉴定出3,028种含量差异蛋白质，其中大多数在批量蛋白质组数据集中未被检出，并构建了细胞类型特异性网络以定义功能模块和枢纽蛋白。与转录组数据比较表明，约30%的蛋白质组变化与RNA不一致。进一步分析发现，保留在人类AD脑中的跨细胞类型信号蛋白，例如多滋养因子（Ptn），其在星形胶质细胞中转录富集，但在小胶质细胞中积累。重要的是，重组PTN可激活人诱导性小胶质细胞（iMG）。因此，这些发现为AD模型提供了全面的细胞类型分辨蛋白质组图谱，揭示了新型细胞内及细胞间信号事件。
